_comment: Team-wide defaults shipped with the plugin. Lowest-priority config layer: a project .figma-design/config.json and ~/.claude/figma-design-generator/config.json both override this. The library below is published to the Atomicwork team, so teammates need no setup -- /figma-library-setup is only for pointing a project at a different design system. If the library is ever republished under a new key, update libraryKey here, bump the version in both manifests and push.
